### 1. Scene
A cooked meal of rice with red sauce, yellow egg-like portions, and browned sliced sausage. The yellow food appears to be scrambled/folded egg, though its identity is somewhat uncertain.

### 2. Vessel
A round dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** in diameter.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**. The partial plate at the left is excluded.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The two yellow portions are estimated separately because their heights differ. Sauce area is counted separately from exposed rice to avoid double-counting.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked white rice | 17% | 90 × 1.9 = 171 ml | 0.8 | 137 g | 130 | 178 kcal |
| Thick scrambled-egg portion, upper right | 18% | 96 × 1.8 = 173 ml | 0.95 | 164 g | 160 | 262 kcal |
| Thin folded/scrambled egg, lower centre | 10% | 53 × 0.65 = 34 ml | 0.95 | 33 g | 160 | 53 kcal |
| Browned sliced sausage | 12% | 64 × 1.25 = 80 ml | 0.95 | 76 g | 300 | 228 kcal |
| Red sauce, likely ketchup | 3% | 16 × 0.7 = 11 ml | 1.0 | 11 g | 110 | 12 kcal |

**Area check:** 17 + 18 + 10 + 12 + 3 = **60% food coverage**, consistent with the visible empty rim and gaps. No separate oil quantity is clearly visible; the egg and sausage energy values account for their prepared state.

### 8. Sanity check
Estimated total: **421 g and 733 kcal**. This is plausible for the visible rice, substantial egg portions, and several sausage slices. Food identification and pile height are the main uncertainties.
